fullContentHtml:
UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online by 6th October 2026 - Complete Details

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Recruitment 2026 notification for Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications from 16-09-2026, and closes on 06-10-2026. The candidate shall apply online through UPSC website, upsc.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Examination 1 : Combined Section Officers' (Grade-'B') Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2026
  • File No. (Section Officers' Exam) : F.No.9/02/2026-E.IB
  • Examination 2 : Combined Stenographers' (Grade-'B'/Grade-'I') Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2022, 2023 & 2024
  • Date of Notification (both exams) : 16.09.2026
  • Examination Type : Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE)
  • Date of Notification of Examination : 16.09.2026
  • UPSC LDCE Last Date for filling up of Application : 06.10.2026 (till 06:00 PM)
  • Last date for receipt of printed copy of application at UPSC (Section Officers' exam, through proper channel) : 23.10.2026
  • Date of Examination : 12.12.2026 & 13.12.2026

Application Fee

  • UPSC LDCE Last Date for filling up of Application : 06.10.2026 (till 06:00 PM)
  • Last date for receipt of printed copy of application at UPSC (Section Officers' exam, through proper channel) : 23.10.2026
  • Official Notification – Stenographers' LDCE : UPSC Stenographers Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
